response.overview: "What’s Up, Boss?" is an award-winning psychological thriller short film blending mystery and drama.  Winner of 8 awards and selected at 20+ international film festivals across Canada, Italy, Mexico, Turkey, the UK, and India, including honors for Best Debut Short Film, Best Indian Short Film, Best Screenplay, and Best Actor.  Not everything is what it seems.  The film is intentionally open to interpretation, inviting viewers to reflect on privacy, judgment, morality, and where we choose to draw our own boundaries.
response.title: What's Up, Boss?
